about_short_description.short_description: Reworkd is an AI-driven automation platform that allows for the automation of business processing workflows to achieve outcomes.

product.name: End-to-End Web Data Extraction Platform
product.description: A platform that automates the entire web data extraction pipeline, including scanning websites, generating extraction code, running extractors, validating results, and outputting data.

product.name: Automated Extraction AI Agents
product.description: AI agents that analyze web pages and automatically generate code to extract targeted data without manual scripting.

product.name: Self-Healing Scrapers
product.description: Scrapers that detect changes in web content and automatically repair extraction failures to maintain data accuracy.

product.name: Deep Analytics Dashboard
product.description: An interactive dashboard providing insights into extraction performance, data quality, and changes in source websites.
